sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', c.date)::date AS ds, SUM(s.sales) AS y FROM m5_sales_train s JOIN m5_calendar c ON s.d = c.d WHERE s.item_id = 'HOUSEHOLD_2_041' GROUP BY ds ORDER BY ds ASC;
sql_explanation: Calculates the total sales (y) for the product HOUSEHOLD_2_041, aggregated by year (ds), to forecast the trend over the next 2 years.
